title: The NIST Cybersecurity Framework (CSF) 2.0 (NIST CSWP 29)
licence: US federal government work (NIST) — not subject to copyright in the US. Attribution: NIST CSWP 29, February 2024.
notes: Comparative (US). The CSF 2.0 Core: 6 Functions, 22 Categories and 106 Subcategories by official ID (e.g. NIST-CSF-2.0-GV.SC-01). Implementation examples and informative references are not part of CSWP 29 and are not held.

ingestion.source_document: NIST CSWP 29, The NIST Cybersecurity Framework (CSF) 2.0, February 26, 2024, 32 pages

watch.note: The registry's NIST source is the NVD CVE feed, not CSF publications — CSF changes are not detected automatically.

clauses.heading: Govern (GV)
clauses.text: The organization’s cybersecurity risk management strategy, expectations, and policy are established, communicated, and monitored

clauses.heading: Organizational Context (GV.OC)
clauses.text: The circumstances — mission, stakeholder expectations, dependencies, and legal, regulatory, and contractual requirements — surrounding the organization’s cybersecurity risk management decisions are understood

clauses.heading: Organizational Context (GV.OC)
clauses.text: The organizational mission is understood and informs cybersecurity risk management

clauses.heading: Organizational Context (GV.OC)
clauses.text: Internal and external stakeholders are understood, and their needs and expectations regarding cybersecurity risk management are understood and considered

clauses.heading: Organizational Context (GV.OC)
clauses.text: Legal, regulatory, and contractual requirements regarding cybersecurity — including privacy and civil liberties obligations — are understood and managed

clauses.heading: Organizational Context (GV.OC)
clauses.text: Critical objectives, capabilities, and services that external stakeholders depend on or expect from the organization are understood and communicated

clauses.heading: Organizational Context (GV.OC)
clauses.text: Outcomes, capabilities, and services that the organization depends on are understood and communicated

clauses.heading: Risk Management Strategy (GV.RM)
clauses.text: The organization’s priorities, constraints, risk tolerance and appetite statements, and assumptions are established, communicated, and used to support operational risk decisions

clauses.heading: Risk Management Strategy (GV.RM)
clauses.text: Risk management objectives are established and agreed to by organizational stakeholders

clauses.heading: Risk Management Strategy (GV.RM)
clauses.text: Risk appetite and risk tolerance statements are established, communicated, and maintained

clauses.heading: Risk Management Strategy (GV.RM)
clauses.text: Cybersecurity risk management activities and outcomes are included in enterprise risk management processes

clauses.heading: Risk Management Strategy (GV.RM)
clauses.text: Strategic direction that describes appropriate risk response options is established and communicated

clauses.heading: Risk Management Strategy (GV.RM)
clauses.text: Lines of communication across the organization are established for cybersecurity risks, including risks from suppliers and other third parties

clauses.heading: Risk Management Strategy (GV.RM)
clauses.text: A standardized method for calculating, documenting, categorizing, and prioritizing cybersecurity risks is established and communicated

clauses.heading: Risk Management Strategy (GV.RM)
clauses.text: Strategic opportunities (i.e., positive risks) are characterized and are included in organizational cybersecurity risk discussions

clauses.heading: Roles, Responsibilities, and Authorities (GV.RR)
clauses.text: Cybersecurity roles, responsibilities, and authorities to foster accountability, performance assessment, and continuous improvement are established and communicated

clauses.heading: Roles, Responsibilities, and Authorities (GV.RR)
clauses.text: Organizational leadership is responsible and accountable for cybersecurity risk and fosters a culture that is risk-aware, ethical, and continually improving

clauses.heading: Roles, Responsibilities, and Authorities (GV.RR)
clauses.text: Roles, responsibilities, and authorities related to cybersecurity risk management are established, communicated, understood, and enforced

clauses.heading: Roles, Responsibilities, and Authorities (GV.RR)
clauses.text: Adequate resources are allocated commensurate with the cybersecurity risk strategy, roles, responsibilities, and policies

clauses.heading: Roles, Responsibilities, and Authorities (GV.RR)
clauses.text: Cybersecurity is included in human resources practices

clauses.heading: Policy (GV.PO)
clauses.text: Organizational cybersecurity policy is established, communicated, and enforced

clauses.heading: Policy (GV.PO)
clauses.text: Policy for managing cybersecurity risks is established based on organizational context, cybersecurity strategy, and priorities and is communicated and enforced

clauses.heading: Policy (GV.PO)
clauses.text: Policy for managing cybersecurity risks is reviewed, updated, communicated, and enforced to reflect changes in requirements, threats, technology, and organizational mission

clauses.heading: Oversight (GV.OV)
clauses.text: Results of organization-wide cybersecurity risk management activities and performance are used to inform, improve, and adjust the risk management strategy

clauses.heading: Oversight (GV.OV)
clauses.text: Cybersecurity risk management strategy outcomes are reviewed to inform and adjust strategy and direction

clauses.heading: Oversight (GV.OV)
clauses.text: The cybersecurity risk management strategy is reviewed and adjusted to ensure coverage of organizational requirements and risks

clauses.heading: Oversight (GV.OV)
clauses.text: Organizational cybersecurity risk management performance is evaluated and reviewed for adjustments needed

clauses.heading: Cybersecurity Supply Chain Risk Management (GV.SC)
clauses.text: Cyber supply chain risk management processes are identified, established, managed, monitored, and improved by organizational stakeholders

clauses.heading: Cybersecurity Supply Chain Risk Management (GV.SC)
clauses.text: A cybersecurity supply chain risk management program, strategy, objectives, policies, and processes are established and agreed to by organizational stakeholders

clauses.heading: Cybersecurity Supply Chain Risk Management (GV.SC)
clauses.text: Cybersecurity roles and responsibilities for suppliers, customers, and partners are established, communicated, and coordinated internally and externally

clauses.heading: Cybersecurity Supply Chain Risk Management (GV.SC)
clauses.text: Cybersecurity supply chain risk management is integrated into cybersecurity and enterprise risk management, risk assessment, and improvement processes

clauses.heading: Cybersecurity Supply Chain Risk Management (GV.SC)
clauses.text: Suppliers are known and prioritized by criticality

clauses.heading: Cybersecurity Supply Chain Risk Management (GV.SC)
clauses.text: Requirements to address cybersecurity risks in supply chains are established, prioritized, and integrated into contracts and other types of agreements with suppliers and other relevant third parties

clauses.heading: Cybersecurity Supply Chain Risk Management (GV.SC)
clauses.text: Planning and due diligence are performed to reduce risks before entering into formal supplier or other third-party relationships

clauses.heading: Cybersecurity Supply Chain Risk Management (GV.SC)
clauses.text: The risks posed by a supplier, their products and services, and other third parties are understood, recorded, prioritized, assessed, responded to, and monitored over the course of the relationship

clauses.heading: Cybersecurity Supply Chain Risk Management (GV.SC)
clauses.text: Relevant suppliers and other third parties are included in incident planning, response, and recovery activities

clauses.heading: Cybersecurity Supply Chain Risk Management (GV.SC)
clauses.text: Supply chain security practices are integrated into cybersecurity and enterprise risk management programs, and their performance is monitored throughout the technology product and service life cycle

clauses.heading: Cybersecurity Supply Chain Risk Management (GV.SC)
clauses.text: Cybersecurity supply chain risk management plans include provisions for activities that occur after the conclusion of a partnership or service agreement

clauses.heading: Identify (ID)
clauses.text: The organization’s current cybersecurity risks are understood

clauses.heading: Asset Management (ID.AM)
clauses.text: Assets (e.g., data, hardware, software, systems, facilities, services, people) that enable the organization to achieve business purposes are identified and managed consistent with their relative importance to organizational objectives and the organization’s risk strategy

clauses.heading: Asset Management (ID.AM)
clauses.text: Inventories of hardware managed by the organization are maintained

clauses.heading: Asset Management (ID.AM)
clauses.text: Inventories of software, services, and systems managed by the organization are maintained

clauses.heading: Asset Management (ID.AM)
clauses.text: Representations of the organization’s authorized network communication and internal and external network data flows are maintained

clauses.heading: Asset Management (ID.AM)
clauses.text: Inventories of services provided by suppliers are maintained

clauses.heading: Asset Management (ID.AM)
clauses.text: Assets are prioritized based on classification, criticality, resources, and impact on the mission

clauses.heading: Asset Management (ID.AM)
clauses.text: Inventories of data and corresponding metadata for designated data types are maintained

clauses.heading: Asset Management (ID.AM)
clauses.text: Systems, hardware, software, services, and data are managed throughout their life cycles

clauses.heading: Risk Assessment (ID.RA)
clauses.text: The cybersecurity risk to the organization, assets, and individuals is understood by the organization

clauses.heading: Risk Assessment (ID.RA)
clauses.text: Vulnerabilities in assets are identified, validated, and recorded

clauses.heading: Risk Assessment (ID.RA)
clauses.text: Cyber threat intelligence is received from information sharing forums and sources

clauses.heading: Risk Assessment (ID.RA)
clauses.text: Internal and external threats to the organization are identified and recorded

clauses.heading: Risk Assessment (ID.RA)
clauses.text: Potential impacts and likelihoods of threats exploiting vulnerabilities are identified and recorded

clauses.heading: Risk Assessment (ID.RA)
clauses.text: Threats, vulnerabilities, likelihoods, and impacts are used to understand inherent risk and inform risk response prioritization

clauses.heading: Risk Assessment (ID.RA)
clauses.text: Risk responses are chosen, prioritized, planned, tracked, and communicated

clauses.heading: Risk Assessment (ID.RA)
clauses.text: Changes and exceptions are managed, assessed for risk impact, recorded, and tracked

clauses.heading: Risk Assessment (ID.RA)
clauses.text: Processes for receiving, analyzing, and responding to vulnerability disclosures are established

clauses.heading: Risk Assessment (ID.RA)
clauses.text: The authenticity and integrity of hardware and software are assessed prior to acquisition and use

clauses.heading: Risk Assessment (ID.RA)
clauses.text: Critical suppliers are assessed prior to acquisition

clauses.heading: Improvement (ID.IM)
clauses.text: Improvements to organizational cybersecurity risk management processes, procedures and activities are identified across all CSF Functions

clauses.heading: Improvement (ID.IM)
clauses.text: Improvements are identified from evaluations

clauses.heading: Improvement (ID.IM)
clauses.text: Improvements are identified from security tests and exercises, including those done in coordination with suppliers and relevant third parties

clauses.heading: Improvement (ID.IM)
clauses.text: Improvements are identified from execution of operational processes, procedures, and activities

clauses.heading: Improvement (ID.IM)
clauses.text: Incident response plans and other cybersecurity plans that affect operations are established, communicated, maintained, and improved

clauses.heading: Protect (PR)
clauses.text: Safeguards to manage the organization’s cybersecurity risks are used

clauses.heading: Identity Management, Authentication, and Access Control (PR.AA)
clauses.text: Access to physical and logical assets is limited to authorized users, services, and hardware and managed commensurate with the assessed risk of unauthorized access

clauses.heading: Identity Management, Authentication, and Access Control (PR.AA)
clauses.text: Identities and credentials for authorized users, services, and hardware are managed by the organization

clauses.heading: Identity Management, Authentication, and Access Control (PR.AA)
clauses.text: Identities are proofed and bound to credentials based on the context of interactions

clauses.heading: Identity Management, Authentication, and Access Control (PR.AA)
clauses.text: Users, services, and hardware are authenticated

clauses.heading: Identity Management, Authentication, and Access Control (PR.AA)
clauses.text: Identity assertions are protected, conveyed, and verified

clauses.heading: Identity Management, Authentication, and Access Control (PR.AA)
clauses.text: Access permissions, entitlements, and authorizations are defined in a policy, managed, enforced, and reviewed, and incorporate the principles of least privilege and separation of duties

clauses.heading: Identity Management, Authentication, and Access Control (PR.AA)
clauses.text: Physical access to assets is managed, monitored, and enforced commensurate with risk

clauses.heading: Awareness and Training (PR.AT)
clauses.text: The organization’s personnel are provided with cybersecurity awareness and training so that they can perform their cybersecurity-related tasks

clauses.heading: Awareness and Training (PR.AT)
clauses.text: Personnel are provided with awareness and training so that they possess the knowledge and skills to perform general tasks with cybersecurity risks in mind

clauses.heading: Awareness and Training (PR.AT)
clauses.text: Individuals in specialized roles are provided with awareness and training so that they possess the knowledge and skills to perform relevant tasks with cybersecurity risks in mind

clauses.heading: Data Security (PR.DS)
clauses.text: Data are managed consistent with the organization’s risk strategy to protect the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of information

clauses.heading: Data Security (PR.DS)
clauses.text: The confidentiality, integrity, and availability of data-at-rest are protected

clauses.heading: Data Security (PR.DS)
clauses.text: The confidentiality, integrity, and availability of data-in-transit are protected

clauses.heading: Data Security (PR.DS)
clauses.text: The confidentiality, integrity, and availability of data-in-use are protected

clauses.heading: Data Security (PR.DS)
clauses.text: Backups of data are created, protected, maintained, and tested

clauses.heading: Platform Security (PR.PS)
clauses.text: The hardware, software (e.g., firmware, operating systems, applications), and services of physical and virtual platforms are managed consistent with the organization’s risk strategy to protect their confidentiality, integrity, and availability

clauses.heading: Platform Security (PR.PS)
clauses.text: Configuration management practices are established and applied

clauses.heading: Platform Security (PR.PS)
clauses.text: Software is maintained, replaced, and removed commensurate with risk

clauses.heading: Platform Security (PR.PS)
clauses.text: Hardware is maintained, replaced, and removed commensurate with risk

clauses.heading: Platform Security (PR.PS)
clauses.text: Log records are generated and made available for continuous monitoring

clauses.heading: Platform Security (PR.PS)
clauses.text: Installation and execution of unauthorized software are prevented

clauses.heading: Platform Security (PR.PS)
clauses.text: Secure software development practices are integrated, and their performance is monitored throughout the software development life cycle

clauses.heading: Technology Infrastructure Resilience (PR.IR)
clauses.text: Security architectures are managed with the organization’s risk strategy to protect asset confidentiality, integrity, and availability, and organizational resilience

clauses.heading: Technology Infrastructure Resilience (PR.IR)
clauses.text: Networks and environments are protected from unauthorized logical access and usage

clauses.heading: Technology Infrastructure Resilience (PR.IR)
clauses.text: The organization’s technology assets are protected from environmental threats

clauses.heading: Technology Infrastructure Resilience (PR.IR)
clauses.text: Mechanisms are implemented to achieve resilience requirements in normal and adverse situations

clauses.heading: Technology Infrastructure Resilience (PR.IR)
clauses.text: Adequate resource capacity to ensure availability is maintained

clauses.heading: Detect (DE)
clauses.text: Possible cybersecurity attacks and compromises are found and analyzed

clauses.heading: Continuous Monitoring (DE.CM)
clauses.text: Assets are monitored to find anomalies, indicators of compromise, and other potentially adverse events

clauses.heading: Continuous Monitoring (DE.CM)
clauses.text: Networks and network services are monitored to find potentially adverse events

clauses.heading: Continuous Monitoring (DE.CM)
clauses.text: The physical environment is monitored to find potentially adverse events

clauses.heading: Continuous Monitoring (DE.CM)
clauses.text: Personnel activity and technology usage are monitored to find potentially adverse events

clauses.heading: Continuous Monitoring (DE.CM)
clauses.text: External service provider activities and services are monitored to find potentially adverse events

clauses.heading: Continuous Monitoring (DE.CM)
clauses.text: Computing hardware and software, runtime environments, and their data are monitored to find potentially adverse events

clauses.heading: Adverse Event Analysis (DE.AE)
clauses.text: Anomalies, indicators of compromise, and other potentially adverse events are analyzed to characterize the events and detect cybersecurity incidents

clauses.heading: Adverse Event Analysis (DE.AE)
clauses.text: Potentially adverse events are analyzed to better understand associated activities

clauses.heading: Adverse Event Analysis (DE.AE)
clauses.text: Information is correlated from multiple sources

clauses.heading: Adverse Event Analysis (DE.AE)
clauses.text: The estimated impact and scope of adverse events are understood

clauses.heading: Adverse Event Analysis (DE.AE)
clauses.text: Information on adverse events is provided to authorized staff and tools

clauses.heading: Adverse Event Analysis (DE.AE)
clauses.text: Cyber threat intelligence and other contextual information are integrated into the analysis

clauses.heading: Adverse Event Analysis (DE.AE)
clauses.text: Incidents are declared when adverse events meet the defined incident criteria

clauses.heading: Respond (RS)
clauses.text: Actions regarding a detected cybersecurity incident are taken

clauses.heading: Incident Management (RS.MA)
clauses.text: Responses to detected cybersecurity incidents are managed

clauses.heading: Incident Management (RS.MA)
clauses.text: The incident response plan is executed in coordination with relevant third parties once an incident is declared

clauses.heading: Incident Management (RS.MA)
clauses.text: Incident reports are triaged and validated

clauses.heading: Incident Management (RS.MA)
clauses.text: Incidents are categorized and prioritized

clauses.heading: Incident Management (RS.MA)
clauses.text: Incidents are escalated or elevated as needed

clauses.heading: Incident Management (RS.MA)
clauses.text: The criteria for initiating incident recovery are applied

clauses.heading: Incident Analysis (RS.AN)
clauses.text: Investigations are conducted to ensure effective response and support forensics and recovery activities

clauses.heading: Incident Analysis (RS.AN)
clauses.text: Analysis is performed to establish what has taken place during an incident and the root cause of the incident

clauses.heading: Incident Analysis (RS.AN)
clauses.text: Actions performed during an investigation are recorded, and the records’ integrity and provenance are preserved

clauses.heading: Incident Analysis (RS.AN)
clauses.text: Incident data and metadata are collected, and their integrity and provenance are preserved

clauses.heading: Incident Analysis (RS.AN)
clauses.text: An incident’s magnitude is estimated and validated

clauses.heading: Incident Response Reporting and Communication (RS.CO)
clauses.text: Response activities are coordinated with internal and external stakeholders as required by laws, regulations, or policies

clauses.heading: Incident Response Reporting and Communication (RS.CO)
clauses.text: Internal and external stakeholders are notified of incidents

clauses.heading: Incident Response Reporting and Communication (RS.CO)
clauses.text: Information is shared with designated internal and external stakeholders

clauses.heading: Incident Mitigation (RS.MI)
clauses.text: Activities are performed to prevent expansion of an event and mitigate its effects

clauses.heading: Incident Mitigation (RS.MI)
clauses.text: Incidents are contained

clauses.heading: Incident Mitigation (RS.MI)
clauses.text: Incidents are eradicated

clauses.heading: Recover (RC)
clauses.text: Assets and operations affected by a cybersecurity incident are restored

clauses.heading: Incident Recovery Plan Execution (RC.RP)
clauses.text: Restoration activities are performed to ensure operational availability of systems and services affected by cybersecurity incidents

clauses.heading: Incident Recovery Plan Execution (RC.RP)
clauses.text: The recovery portion of the incident response plan is executed once initiated from the incident response process

clauses.heading: Incident Recovery Plan Execution (RC.RP)
clauses.text: Recovery actions are selected, scoped, prioritized, and performed

clauses.heading: Incident Recovery Plan Execution (RC.RP)
clauses.text: The integrity of backups and other restoration assets is verified before using them for restoration

clauses.heading: Incident Recovery Plan Execution (RC.RP)
clauses.text: Critical mission functions and cybersecurity risk management are considered to establish post-incident operational norms

clauses.heading: Incident Recovery Plan Execution (RC.RP)
clauses.text: The integrity of restored assets is verified, systems and services are restored, and normal operating status is confirmed

clauses.heading: Incident Recovery Plan Execution (RC.RP)
clauses.text: The end of incident recovery is declared based on criteria, and incident- related documentation is completed

clauses.heading: Incident Recovery Communication (RC.CO)
clauses.text: Restoration activities are coordinated with internal and external parties

clauses.heading: Incident Recovery Communication (RC.CO)
clauses.text: Recovery activities and progress in restoring operational capabilities are communicated to designated internal and external stakeholders

clauses.heading: Incident Recovery Communication (RC.CO)
clauses.text: Public updates on incident recovery are shared using approved methods and messaging
